sources.name: Weighting note (not a source)

list: The Notorious B.I.G.|biggie|biggie smalls|notorious big|notorious b.i.g.|the notorious big|big|b.i.g.|notorious
changes_vs_current: Method change after review: naming and fame now count ahead of likability (Family Feud x2; fame, Spotify and RIAA x1; the two likability measures x0.5). Every move below is against the original current list.
Eminem #1 and Drake #2 unchanged: Eminem leads every measure; Drake is #1 on Spotify, #2 on RIAA and 8th on fame, but was guessed on Family Feud and not on the board.
Tupac #4 -> #3: Family Feud 2nd, RIAA 3rd, fame 9th.
Snoop Dogg #6 -> #4: Family Feud 1st (the only naming survey). He is not in YouGov's rap Ratings category, so he is skipped there.
Kanye West #8 -> #5: the most famous rapper (96% fame), Spotify 2nd, RIAA 5th. Likability (34%) now weighs less.
Jay-Z #7 -> #6: fame 3rd (93%), RIAA 4th, Family Feud 8th, Spotify 22nd (listed on kworb as 'JAŸ-Z', #82 overall).
50 Cent #5 -> #7: Family Feud 7th, fame 6th, Spotify 26th among rappers.
Kendrick Lamar #3 -> #8: Spotify 5th, but fame only 17th among rappers (83%) and he was guessed on Family Feud and not on the board.

The Notorious B.I.G. #16 -> #9: Family Feud 6th, and no naming-type source puts him lower. He sits at #14 on the weighted average, held down by fame (18th, 83%) and Spotify (#284 overall), so he is placed by the naming survey on the coordinator's call.
Dr. Dre #14 -> #10: Family Feud 4th, and no naming-type source puts him lower. Weighted average 12.0; fame 14th (87%), Spotify #214 overall.
Lil Wayne #10 -> #11: fame 11th, Spotify 9th, RIAA 6th, but he was guessed on Family Feud and not on the board.
Nicki Minaj #9 -> #12: fame 5th (92%), Spotify 8th, popularity only 23rd.
LL Cool J #11 -> #13: Family Feud 5th, but fame is only 16th among rappers (84%) and he is near-absent on Spotify. His case rested mainly on likability.

Ice Cube #13 -> #14: no net change from the original list (#13). He is not on the Family Feud board. Fame is 4th (92%), but he leaned on likability (1st) and has almost no streams (#652). Down from #6 in the first draft of this re-rank.
Cardi B NEW at #15: fame 7th (91%), Spotify 24th among rappers.
Pitbull #15 -> #16: kept. Fame 15th (85%), popularity 12th, Spotify 19th among rappers (#74 overall).
MC Hammer NEW at #17: fame 12th (87%), popularity 5th.
Travis Scott #22 -> #18: Spotify 3rd among rappers.
Ludacris #17 -> #19: fame 13th (87%), popularity 10th.
Future #23 -> #20 and Juice WRLD stays at #21 (was #24): Spotify 6th and 7th among rappers; both have little fame data.
Missy Elliott #18 -> #22: fame 21st (78%); she leaned on likability (6th).
Vanilla Ice NEW at #23: fame 10th (89%).
J. Cole #12 -> #24: fame only 57%, guessed on Family Feud and not on the board. Spotify 13th among rappers. Tie with Doja Cat broken by number of sources.

OUT: Nas (#21): about 42nd on the data (fame 67%, Spotify #610, guessed on Family Feud and not on the board). Andre 3000 (#20): outside the rapper top 29 everywhere. Nelly (#19): falls to about 27th once likability is down-weighted (fame 79%, Spotify #445).
confidence: medium: the top 8 is stable under every weighting, but the only naming survey (Family Feud, 100 people) is what lifts Biggie and Dre into #9-#10; on the weighted average they sit at #14 and #12.
